name: Versatile Performance
text:
You can rely on the grandeur of your performances rather than ordinary social skills. You can use Performance instead of Diplomacy to make-an-impression statistic=performance and instead of Intimidation to demoralize statistic=performance. You can also use an acting Performance instead of Deception to impersonate statistic=performance.

In addition, you can use your proficiency rank in Performance to meet the prerequisites of skill feats that require a particular proficiency rank in Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation.
